extract_html_from_warc: run the script with a job index to extract HTML from WARC files in an S3 dataset
get_image_urls: run the script to extract and save image URLs from web documents to a text file
simplify_dom_tree: configure the DOMTreeSimplificator with CSS rules and tag stripping options to clean HTML
extract_web_documents: use CommonCrawlWebDocumentExtractor to convert raw HTML datasets into structured web document datasets
save_dataset_to_s3: run the script to save the processed web document dataset without images to an S3 bucket
